name: 922 Difficulty Stamper
description: Scans a 922 batch's part drawings for the DriveWorks DIFFICULT label, stamps DIFFICULT on that order's work packet, then removes the label from the drawings it came from. Re-running keeps packets honest: an order that is no longer difficult has its stamp removed.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder.
The parts must already be modeled - the app reads the part drawings under each order's CAD-AND-SHOP-PRINTS folder. Orders that aren't modeled yet are reported and skipped.
Close the work-packet PDFs if they're open in a viewer, so they can be re-saved with the stamp.
how_it_works: Pick the batch's own 'Batch NNN' folder when the picker opens - no batch number typing.
For each order it reads every part drawing under CAD-AND-SHOP-PRINTS and looks for the DIFFICULT label DriveWorks prints on parts with a compound cut.
If any part in the order is difficult, it stamps DIFFICULT in red on the first page of that order's work packet.
Once the packet is stamped, the blue DIFFICULT label is removed from the part drawings it came from - the packet now carries the flag, so the drawing doesn't need to.
If an order was stamped before but none of its parts are difficult any more, the old stamp is removed.
output: Work packets stamped DIFFICULT, cleaned-up part drawings, plus a summary listing which orders are difficult and which parts made them difficult.
